description: Java class representing a Performance Metric entity for use with Spring Data MongoDB, including fields such as employeeId, metricType, score, timestamp, and note.

classes.name: PerformanceMetric
classes.description: Entity class mapped to the 'metrics' MongoDB collection, encapsulating performance measurement data for employees.

methods.name: PerformanceMetric(String, MetricType, double, Instant, String)
methods.description: Parameterized constructor to initialize all fields.

methods.name: getId()
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the performance metric.

methods.name: getEmployeeId()
methods.description: Returns the employee identifier associated with the metric.

methods.name: getScore()
methods.description: Returns the score value of the metric.

methods.name: getTimestamp()
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the metric was recorded.

methods.name: getNote()
methods.description: Returns additional notes related to the metric.

methods.name: setId(String)
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the metric.

methods.name: setTimestamp(Instant)
methods.description: Sets the timestamp of the metric.

methods.name: setNote(String)
methods.description: Sets the note associated with the metric.
